$comment: Packages the apps must never contain. scope anywhere: fail when the package is anywhere in package-lock.json; scope direct: fail only as a direct dependency of a workspace (some tools pull HTTP clients in transitively).

packages.reason: The Shell owns one React Navigation 7 stack; Expo Router (SDK 56+) forbids @react-navigation/* imports in app code.
OTA updates are network traffic (N3); restart with reloadAppAsync from expo and keep updates.enabled false.
Ships a network inspector; Release builds are tested without Metro.
Its default reachability probe fetches clients3.google.com from our bundle (N3); use expo-network.
Its plugin adds NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, background audio and record permissions by default; use react-native-audio-api.
RevenueCat: every purchase goes through its servers (N2).
A second IAP stack (Nitro) with the same core; use expo-iap.
Web views are a network surface (N3); @expo/dom-webview comes with expo and is allowed installed but banned from imports.
No ATT prompt in v1; its plugin writes a tracking string.
A pre-1.0 native dependency; reloadAppAsync from expo covers restarts.
N3: our app code makes no requests; tooling uses the built-in fetch.
